For Sale | 121m² Ground Floor Retail Space in Lindora – Santa Ana ID26324

Excellent opportunity to buy a 121m² commercial space located on the ground floor in one of the most dynamic and high-traffic areas of Lindora, Santa Ana.

This location is ideal for businesses seeking visibility, accessibility, and proximity to major corporate centers, restaurants, and residential communities.

Property Features:
• 121 m² of usable space
• Ground floor location for easy customer access
• Excellent visibility and exposure
• Flexible layout suitable for retail, showroom, or service businesses
• Convenient access for clients and staff

Strategic Location – Lindora

Lindora is one of the most active commercial and corporate zones in Santa Ana, known for its:
• High daily traffic
• Proximity to office centers and multinational companies
• Restaurants, cafés, and retail stores
• Easy access to Route 27

This space is ideal for:
• Retail stores
• Showrooms
• Service-oriented businesses
• Boutique concepts

A great opportunity to Invest or establish your business in a prime commercial location in Santa Ana.
